slearner_scenarios.holm_family: all comparisons in the main, null, correlated and misspec cells
slearner_scenarios.misspec_note: misspec cell: main DGP, the T-learner CATE model (both arms) drops login_freq while the S-learner keeps all four features, as in the paper; S-Learner vs CATE x LTV there is the paired test of that contrast.  The main cell is the full-feature comparison.

asym.holm_family: all comparisons on the asymmetric DGP

effective_welfare.holm_family: nominal-vs-effective per strategy and each strategy's overstatement vs CATE Only

component_update.holm_family: well-specified vs misspecified V, both arms

corr_sweep.holm_family: all comparisons across the three gamma cells

heavy_tail.holm_family: all comparisons on the heavy-tailed DGP

obs_diagnostic.note: CATE share = cate_term / (cate_term + value_term): a share of the telescoping BOUND on the mean absolute score gap over the misranked set, in one fixed order (CATE error at the reference V, then value error at the deployed tau_hat); not a regret decomposition (see core.policy.regret_split)
obs_diagnostic.holm_family: per-replication CATE share, misspec vs wellspec, over the 2 arms x 3 references

aipw_calibration.holm_family: AIPW-calibrated vs identity, both arms (the degenerate plug-in comparisons are excluded)
aipw_calibration.note: config index 0 is the near-identity g~1; index 3 is default theta0.  A comparison mean_diff is the true test welfare of the calibrated rule minus the g=1 (CATE x LTV) rule.  The plug-in objective selects identity by construction (difference exactly 0, p = 1; flagged degenerate and excluded from the Holm family).  Proposition 3 implies no g improves on identity at the population optimum (true tau and V); with estimated components that need not hold, so a negative or zero mean is an empirical observation, not a consequence of the proposition.

adversarial.holm_family: all comparisons across both kappa cells
adversarial.interpretation: If CATE x LTV minus CATE Only is <= 0 under the dropout (value weighting does NOT beat pure CATE), the value model failed to rescue the dropped signal, bounding the favourable login-drop result in the main misspecification table.

like_for_like.holm_family: all-features vs dropped, S-learner and both T arms, both cells
